$neutralizeNote: DE-BRAND rules for the Gateway settings page: unlike `rules` (which rebrand Hermes -> <brand>), these REMOVE the product name so the gateway reads as a generic 'Gateway'/'Cloud'/'backend'. Applied BEFORE `rules` (so they consume the 'Hermes' before the generic rule can turn it into the brand) and ONLY when the brand is active (name != 'Hermes'), so `base` builds stay stock. NOT managed by the brand generator (scripts/brand/emitters/brand-config.mjs only owns `name` + `rules`), so this array is carried verbatim across restamps and merges and applies to EVERY brand. Ordering is significant: most-specific/longest phrases first. The first three are EXACT full-copy matches, deliberately scoped so the product name 'Hermes Desktop' is only neutralized in the gateway intro/local/remote copy — it stays branded on About, the version footer, onboarding, etc. (a blanket 'Hermes Desktop' rule would wrongly strip those). If upstream reworks a gateway string, its rule silently stops matching (the string reverts to branded, no build/merge break) — re-verify with the gateway greps in the otto-upstream-merge skill.
$protectNote: protect = regexes for FUNCTIONAL title-case 'Hermes' strings that must NOT be rebranded: the X-Hermes-Session-Token auth header (rewriting it breaks desktop↔backend auth → 401) and the Hermes-Desktop User-Agent. Matches are masked before rules run and restored after. Add any newly-discovered functional 'Hermes' string here. NOTE: 'Hermes\.app' is intentionally NOT protected — the mac updater's relaunch paths (main.ts release/mac*/…app) must become OTTO.app because electron-builder outputs the app under productName (OTTO); protecting it left self-update looking for a non-existent Hermes.app.
$rulesNote: Rules are [regexPattern, replacement], applied in order with the global flag and CASE SENSITIVITY. Case-sensitive \bHermes\b matches only the title-case display word; \bHERMES\b handles ALL-CAPS display text (e.g. the intro wordmark 'HERMES AGENT' -> 'OTTO AGENT'). Neither matches identifiers: HERMES_HOME / hermes_cli / .hermes / resolveHermesBackend all differ in case or are glued to word chars (the underscore in HERMES_HOME blocks \bHERMES\b). Anything in `protect` is exempt. Add more specific phrase rules BEFORE the generic one if a surface needs different wording.
